# rendering-core

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-001 — A reader reads a faithful rendering of any document](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-001.md) — When a writer opens or edits a Markdown file, the Studio SHALL show a rendered preview of its content beside the editor that follows each edit and displays text in any script and direction readably inside the preview column.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-002 — A writer composes a document from included files](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-002.md) — When a document includes other Markdown files, the Studio SHALL show the included content in place and let the writer edit it from the include location.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-003 — A reader sees what cannot be rendered and keeps a usable preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-003.md) — When content cannot be rendered or loaded, or a render fails, the Studio SHALL show a visible placeholder, a listed warning, the last good page marked as outdated or an error page with the failure message instead of a silent gap, and keep showing the previous page until a newer render is ready.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-004 — Read text in any script and direction](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-004.md) — When a document contains CJK, right-to-left text or long unbreakable words, the Studio SHALL display it readably inside the preview column.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-005 — Keep the preview usable when a render fails](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-005.md) — When a render fails, the Studio SHALL keep the last good page marked as outdated or show an error page with the failure message, and when a newer edit supersedes a render, the Studio SHALL keep showing the previous page until the newer render is ready.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
